body: FIRST CUT (ac-2/ac-3): setup done (scripts/m2v_witness_extract.py; gold 931 + train 131k m2v embeddings extracted). Boundary = representation.text.word (82 gold, the hardest semantic residual = the witness's unique region). m2v->ydf GBT (200 trees, owner's exact design): gold AUC 0.838 (real signal) BUT precision>=0.80/0.90/0.95 only to recall 0.024 — precision collapses at the top because the residual confusors (plain_text/categorical/entity_name/alphanumeric_id) sit too close to word in the m2v embedding. WEAK standalone veto. Consistent with m2v sep 0.80 < gte 0.89. NEXT: the two-sided GATE form (override only where model band low/med AND witness high) is the deciding test before NO-GO. Substrate output/m2v-witness-pilot/RESULT.md.

VERDICT NO-GO (framework). The full-bucket sweep (sweep_result.md) settles it before wiring: the cheap per-class m2v->GBT witness carves a high-precision region ONLY on closed-vocabulary types (country, year, country_code, isbn) — three of four already Sharpen-owned. The lone semantic win is country (R@P.90 0.818), which is a gazetteer lookup better served by the deterministic Tier-C region/country gazetteer reader. The open residual that motivated the witness (word, plain_text, entity_name, alphanumeric_id, city) is uncrackable even at near-perfect AUC (city AUC 0.987 / R@P.90 0.000). ac-4 (wire two-sided gate) and ac-5 (corpus-honest gate) are MOOT — nothing to wire/gate; the NO-GO precedes them. Methodology keeper: AUC is the wrong instrument for an abstaining veto; precision-at-recall is the gate.
